briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI accelerate frontier model releases as global compute race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: AI development pace remains relentless with multiple frontier labs shipping updates. Funding continues at record levels while regulatory scrutiny grows. Prompt injection and multi-agent security emerge as critical bottlenecks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with advanced reasoning; xAI releases Grok-4; DeepSeek launches V3.5 claiming parity on key benchmarks. Meta's Llama 4 enters public testing amid competitive pressure.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with new automotive CAN bus pilots underway.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly; Microsoft announces $15B Arizona supercluster; Google TPU v6 clusters now operational in three regions.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dynamic dialects become mandatory infrastructure before 2028?
